title: Junk that rusts.
text:
Junk that rusts.. Junk -- horrible rust.

While the tongs themselves may be stainless steel, the rivet and the piece that holds the tongs closed are not. I wish I had photographed these tongs before I threw them in the garbage to show the rust.

Pay more and get tongs that will not rust. This selection is a waste of your money.
